     "subtitle": "The Hajduk anthem and the autumn start: a derby victory of the kind the fan has been waiting for",
     "screenshot_description": "The Host and both guests at the table at the beginning of the episode, smiling after the victory over Dinamo",
     "content": "The episode of Iza Pjace #151 opens with the song „Because of One Love“ about the tireless fan relationship toward the club. Its lyrics about support and „after victory and when things aren't going well for you“ fully match the mood of the show, which comes after a long-awaited celebration. After the musical intro the Host greets the viewers and announces that the autumn madness has started in the best possible way: **Hajduk's victory over Dinamo 2:1, after a comeback**.\n\nThe Host says that because of this hosting the show is a special pleasure for him, and in the studio he was kept company by Danko and Mate, whom he calls the Kaštela duo. Danko immediately sums up the mood with a short „We won“. Mate adds that a comeback in the derby at Poljud should be remembered as something that does not happen often.\n\nThe Host recalls a recent match from the season in which Hajduk „broke Dinamo from free kicks“. Then, he stresses, it was already clear that the championship is not played for important points. That is why this victory is dearer to him, because it was won in a match with a real stake. A humorous recollection follows of a stand choreography with a quotation from an old fan song, of the slogan about the „black devil“, and of the morning post of a fan page with a „skinny dog“. According to that post, Dinamo behaved like a skinny dog that has been left behind. The Host adds to this that with such optimistic references it is nevertheless always good to be careful.\n\nThe trio agrees that a victory with a comeback is an ideal start to autumn and the end of the first quarter of the season. The Host also mentions that coach Garcia **finally won a derby**, and Mate adds that nobody can now reproach him for that any more. A continuation is also announced in which Hajduk will host Ajax on Thursday, so the Host concludes that, if Hajduk can win a derby, few things would be impossible.",

Danko stresses that Dominguez was burying Bamba and opening space elsewhere, but precisely because of that Dominguez was „to blame“ for Hajduk's first goal. Had he not been on him, he would probably have scored, because he is a killer in the penalty area.\n\nMate concludes that against such players goals are conceded.
